_why: Gate 2 fails on a SKIPPED test unless its reason is one of these. A skip is a test that did not run, and the gate used to read only the exit status: `test_templates.py` skipped itself for want of jinja2 and the template repairs were never exercised by the report that said the gate passed. Every entry names a reason that is a property of the release, not of the machine, and a package a run needs belongs in _experiments/env/requirements-eval.txt instead.

allowed.why: replaced every Memgraph path with DuckDB/NetworkX; the driver is an app-only extra and no tool needs it
streamlit, plotly, streamlit-option-menu and anthropic are in requirements.txt, not requirements-tools.txt; the evaluation stack does not install them
the raw source table is not released; the published parquet is what the tools read
the pre-parquet CSV is not released
_docs is a working directory that is not part of the release
